messages.subject: Temporary emigration (gmultmix) model: subscript out of bounds error
parts:
Hello,

I am relatively new to unmarked and I am having some issues developing the models in gmultmix. A forum search has led me to believe that very few have run into this problem at this particular stage of the analysis. I would greatly appreciate some insight. I have developed the unmarkedFrameGMM and and examined the summary with no results appearing out of the ordinary; yet, when I run a null model an error message "Error in p[,5] : subscript out of bounds" appears.

As a brief background, the data I am looking at consists of a time-of-detection analysis with 12 visits to 41 locations wherein each visit consisted of 4 counts. Not all of the sites were surveyed 12 times range = (9,12) and apparently, some covariate data is sporadically missing (designated NA).     

Here is my unmarkedFrameGMM and respective summary.

test1 <- unmarkedFrameGMM(y=wtdo_ch.Hmat,
                              siteCovs=lc_df,
                              yearlySiteCovs=list(date=Covariates[,2:13], time=Covariates[,26:37], observ=Covariates[,14:25], temp=Covariates[,50:61], meanW=Covariates[,74:85], maxW=Covariates[,86:97], CC=Covariates[,98:109], AN=Covariates[,110:121]),
                              obsCovs=list(interval=cbind(intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat,intervalMat)),
                              obsToY=o2yGMM,
                              piFun="crPiFun", 
                              numPrimary=nVisits)

parts:
Since no comments have been made, I thought I might expound upon the issue by adding that I have simplified the data to simply run a test of the potential causes. I removed all sites with one or more NA's in the yearlySiteCovs as well as reduced the number of covariates in the unmarkedFrameGMM. Upon doing this, I ran the same null model as above and got received the same error message "Error in p[,5] : subscript out of bounds". I don't understand why this is occurring.

Tom

messages.author: 79b26df86d17ca9f
messages.subject: Re: Temporary emigration (gmultmix) model: subscript out of bounds error
parts:
While dissecting each part of my unmarkedFrameGMM I isolated the issue to be in the PiFun. To hopefully prevent anyone else from making this rudimentary mistake, I will briefly explain. I had incorrectly defined where PiFun was to draw the captureHistory data from, specifying the function to locate data in columns I knew to host the captureHistory (in Y) not realizing that the unmarkedFrameGMM calls for a generalized function. Entering 4 different cell values makes a world of difference. 

Thank you for thought devoted to the problem,

Tom
